name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. 'typeC' is the established sibling-set discriminator parallel to fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_main and fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_typeB: the three are dispatched from fd2_chapter_transition_with_intro by data_fd2_chapter_intro_menu_cursor_state (state 4 -> typeC, BGM 0xB). The suffix is a meaningful variant tag, not a Ghidra address residue (it is not a hex value matching this or any data address). Name accurately reflects the role (town-chapter services menu: Status/Give/Revive/Promote).
purpose: Run the TYPE-C chapter-intro menu (the 'town' chapter services screen used when chapter_transition_state==4): a 4-way Status/Give/Revive/Promote dispatch over an FDOTHER BG image with a live money panel, with no begin-battle branch; always returns 0.
logic_summary: __CHK(0x3C) prologue. Read chapter-meta category byte (EAX-after-CALL of fd2_get_chapter_intro_metadata_entry; captured before the loop because the pose tables are indexed by category*6+cursor_state in the outro). Load fixed FDOTHER BG image idx 0x0E into data_fd2_ui_menu_screen_sprite_atlas_buf_ptr, blit to 0xA0000, fade in, delay 200ms, paint speaker portrait (speaker_portrait_id_table[4]=0x83). Render money panel both live (panel sprite at atlas[+0x0A]; blit to 0xA76C5; decimal gold at 0xA7BD0) and into slide-snapshot shadow buffer (ui_slide_bg_snapshot+0x76C5 / +0x7BD0); both decimals x=0x1F, 8 digits. Show greeting dialog 0x249, paint portrait. Main loop: set live cursor from stored cursor, play open anim, run shared fd2_chapter_intro_menu_input_loop, save cursor on commit, play outro anim, unconditionally fd2_close_intro_dialog_with_slide_out; on commit (low byte==1) dispatch by data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx (0=status, 1=give, 2=revive @0x30DC3, 3=promote @0x31385), re-show greeting 0x24A. Loops while input==1; cancel(-1) exits. Exit: blit BG image, delay, fade to black, then 11-frame pose-out (i=10..0) nearest-neighbour-scaling pose_bitmap via fd2_blit_scaled_chapter_pose (src_cx from y-row table -0x96 +0x5000, src_cy from x-column table -0x64 +0x3200, both scaled i/10*0x80; scale 0x80-i*9), committing each frame from data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr and ramping brightness via fd2_set_vga_palette_range. Free BG atlas, NULL it, return 0. Tail-jumps into shared epilogue inside fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_main @0x2FF84.

params.name: pose_bitmap
params.semantics: Caller-allocated 64000-byte VGA backdrop snapshot (malloc'd in fd2_chapter_transition_with_intro from a memmove of 0xA0000). Used only as the bitmap source for the fade-to-black scaled-pose outro animation (passed to fd2_blit_scaled_chapter_pose each frame). Owned and freed by the caller; this function does not free it.
params.reason: Accurate descriptive name with no address residue; matches the identically-purposed parameter in the sibling fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_main.

returns.semantics: Always 0. typeC is a pure-services menu with no 'start battle' branch; it exits only via cancel back to the chapter-transition flow (caller treats 0 as 'did not advance/commit').

reads_globals: data_fd2_ui_slide_bg_snapshot_buf_ptr (0x53C5F) -- shadow buffer base for money panel
data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr (0x53A49) -- per-frame composite source for VGA commit
writes_globals: data_fd2_ui_menu_screen_sprite_atlas_buf_ptr (0x54147) -- set to loaded atlas, then freed and set to 0
data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx (0x53C57) -- reset to stored cursor each loop iteration
